verdict.line: You win the 1v1 and the solo-kill race up to level 5-6, but the matchup sits at 38.7% over 62 games because Teemo's kiting and mushrooms take the game away from you after that.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks into a shockwave pull that punishes any Teemo push inside 450 range, which is why K'Sante holds lane and solo-kill advantage early. But Teemo's Blinding Dart has only an 8s cooldown and completely denies the attack that detonates Dauntless Instinct marks, so every all-in has to be timed around it rather than forced through it. Past level 6, Noxious Trap hands Teemo permanent zone control at a 230 range with a 1s redeploy cooldown, and his 680 range outranges every K'Sante tool except the 525-range E — that's the structural reason the measured win rate collapses to 38.7% despite the early lane win.

theirWindow.what: He blinds you the moment you commit, erasing the auto that detonates Dauntless Instinct marks. Don't charge W (Path Maker) into a live Q — bait it out with E (Footwork) poke first or wait the 8s.

yourWindow.when: Right after Teemo fires his Q
yourWindow.what: Blinding Dart is down for a full 8s. Charge W (Path Maker) and dash in immediately — Move Quick can't out-sprint the knockback/stun, and his only answer to the follow-up trade is gone.

powerCurve.note: Q stacks/shockwave punish early melee pushes
Noxious Trap and blind deny your dives
Kaenic Rookern tanks poison, farm resets lane
Short 250-range R struggles vs kiting comp

start.why: Measured at 45.9% win rate over 37 games — the flat damage block and regen eat Teemo's low-damage poke autos far better than Doran's Helm's 32.5% over 40 games.

boots.why: 40% win rate over 50 games vs 36.4% for Plated Steelcaps. The magic resist directly answers Teemo's poison, and the tenacity shortens how long his debuffs stick.

core.why: The magic-damage shield absorbs Teemo's ranged poke and poison ticks before you're ever in his face.
Gives Q (Ntofo Strikes) the AoE-on-hit and CDR to stack faster and threaten the shockwave pull sooner in a trade.

This path hit 28.6% win rate over 7 games, the largest sample of the three measured core routes — stacking resistances lets you sit in extended trades where Teemo's E (Toxic Shot) DoT would otherwise outlast you.

situational.when: teemo itemizes into attack speed or on-hit to stack toxic shot procs faster
the enemy team adds more auto-attack or crit carries kiting alongside teemo
you're grouping with another frontline or AD carry for teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: Measured at 33.3% win rate (23.1% pick), the strongest recorded keystone for this matchup. The bonus resistances trigger off your W (Path Maker) stun, making the all-in you're forced to time around Blinding Dart actually survivable.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the standard pick at 78.2% (37.7% win rate), giving you wave-state flexibility against a champion who out-ranges you and can split-push behind mushrooms. Exhaust+Flash measured higher at 50% but over a much smaller 7.7%-pick sample — worth considering if you're playing to force all-ins, since Exhaust cuts both Teemo's kiting speed and his sustained poison DPS during All Out.

playing.title: Punish melee-range pushes early
playing.detail: If Teemo steps inside 450 to last-hit or poke, answer with Q (Ntofo Strikes). At 2 stacks the shockwave pulls him in, which is the only way to deny his Move Quick kite before 6.

playing.title: Time all-ins around Blinding Dart
playing.detail: Never start charging W (Path Maker) into a live Q — the blind stops the auto that detonates your Dauntless Instinct mark and strips the trade of its payoff.

playing.title: Scout bushes once he hits 6
playing.detail: Noxious Trap redeploys every 1s, so Teemo can seed multiple mushrooms fast. Don't blind-dash E (Footwork) into unscouted brush near your engage path.

playing.title: Use E to close range, not just escape
playing.detail: Footwork's dash reaches further when targeting an ally — use it to re-enter trades quickly since Teemo's 680 range outreaches your 450 Q by a wide margin.

playing.title: Don't fire R from max range
playing.detail: All Out's knockback is only 250 range. You need to already be in melee — use W or E to close the gap first, or the cooldown (120/100/80/80/80s) is wasted.

playing.title: Stop forcing solo all-ins after 15
playing.detail: Your power curve drops off late because his kiting plus trap zoning beats isolated dives. Group or split-push instead of trying to solo-win fights.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win rates/sample sizes above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning tying them to K'Sante's and Teemo's abilities is my own read, not measured data.
